objective: Stable finite Minkowski gauge pulses, then a resolved wormhole-to-trumpet transition retaining the Minkowski hyperboloidal reference.
acceptance: Not achieved. Wider transitions lower initial spatial defects, but N24 t=2 constraint norms grow; negative continuation/source controls are preserved.

runtime_build.scope: All production native runs below match the clean runtime executable. Later changes affect documentation and the standalone tangent diagnostic only.

workspace_at_launch.scope: Workspace at launch; executable build-source equality is not inferred

cases.name: finite-angular-N24
cases.input_text:
<job>
basename=hyp

<mesh>
nx1=24
nx2=24
nx3=24
nghost=3
x1min=-1.05
x1max=1.05
x2min=-1.05
x2max=1.05
x3min=-1.05
x3max=1.05
ix1_bc=outflow

nx2=24
nx3=24

evolution=dynamic
integrator=rk3
cfl_number=0.4
nlim=2
tlim=0.001
ndiag=1

variable=z4c

data.verdict: Quartic spherical closure worsens the outer constraint tangent and produces a negative-determinant rejection before t=.5. Preserve as a negative control; retain quadratic for wider-transition evolution.

data.method: Unchanged versioned Cartesian native tangent source compiled using ignored include overlays. Only prototype constructor default exponent is changed. Production controls reuse immutable same-source p2 baseline receipt. Full actual stencils, final-stage algebraic projector, analytic jets and diagnostics retained.
data.family_verdict: Powers1–4 do not improve production Hdot RMS at broad a=.5 N24/36/48. Power4 lowers all bulk maxima but spreads the source and increases N48 M/Z rates. Stop under requested RMS criterion; no cubic or finer-grid extensions for p3/p4.
